channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: French Bus Accident Results in Two Fatalities
item.description: Local authorities report that a bus crash in France has claimed the lives of a child and a young adult, while leaving several others injured.

item.title: Spark Gear Announces Anniversary Sale Discounts
item.description: Fashion brand Spark Gear is offering anniversary discounts of up to thirty percent on apparel and merchandise, alongside twenty percent off cosmetics. This promotional event will run for ten days.

item.title: Photo Highlights from Rangpur and Rangamati
item.description: Visuals from November 6, 2026, capture the Aman rice harvest underway in Rangpur alongside weekend visitors crossing the hanging bridge over Kaptai Lake in Rangamati.

item.title: Delhi-NCR Enforces Stage-III Pollution Measures
item.description: The Commission for Air Quality Management activated GRAP-III restrictions across the National Capital Region immediately after Delhi's air quality index reached 382.

item.title: Analysis on Democratic Shifts in Republican Strongholds
item.description: An editorial commentary examines how the Democratic Party successfully secured victories in traditionally Republican-leaning areas.

item.title: Jannik Sinner's Coach to Step Down
item.description: The trainer who assisted Jannik Sinner in achieving the top world ranking and five Grand Slam victories plans to exit the team by the close of the year.

item.title: Overview of Europe's Black Bloc Demonstrators
item.description: Anarchist protesters wearing black apparel frequently engage in clashes with law enforcement during demonstrations spanning from France to Albania.

item.title: Tanzanian Opposition Figure Convicted of Unrest Incitement
item.description: A 58-year-old opposition politician held in custody since April of last year was convicted of inciting unrest though cleared of treason, maintaining that the accusations are politically driven.

item.title: Macao Tribunal Imposes 12.5-Year Prison Term on Former Lawmaker
item.description: A former Macao politician has received a 12.5-year prison sentence. The judiciary convicted him of subversion and circulating false claims to undermine the 2024 local elections.

item.title: মোটরসাইকেলের ফুয়েল ট্যাংক দ্রুত নষ্ট হওয়ার কারণ অনুসন্ধান
item.description: বিভিন্ন ব্র্যান্ডের মোটরসাইকেলের ফুয়েল ট্যাংক মাত্র তিন বছরের মধ্যে ফুটো হয়ে যাওয়ায় চালকেরা নতুন ট্যাংক কিনতে বাধ্য হচ্ছেন। জ্বালানির মান নাকি ট্যাংক তৈরির ধাতুর ত্রুটি এর জন্য দায়ী, তা ভিডিওতে তুলে ধরা হয়েছে।

item.title: Newcastle United Defender Amar Dedic Questioned by Police Over Bow and Arrows
item.description: Newcastle United player Amar Dedic faces a police inquiry. Authorities stopped him after he was seen carrying a bow and arrows in a Northumberland scenic area.

item.title: PCB to Issue NOCs for Abu Dhabi T10 League Following Financial Agreement
item.description: The Pakistan Cricket Board will grant No Objection Certificates for the Abu Dhabi T10 tournament. In exchange, the board will obtain a lump sum financial payment from the competition organizers.

item.title: Magnitude 6.1 Earthquake Hits Near Tokyo Without Tsunami Danger
item.description: An earthquake measuring 6.1 in magnitude occurred near Tokyo, Japan, on Friday. Seismological agencies confirmed that no tsunami warning was issued following the tremor.

item.title: Police Arrest Multiple Climate Protestors at Amsterdam Microsoft Data Facility
item.description: Several climate activists were taken into custody after breaching a Microsoft data center construction area in Amsterdam.

item.title: European Airspace on Alert After Recent Wave of False Bomb Threats
item.description: False bomb alerts across Europe have disrupted commercial aviation this week, resulting in at least 35 aircraft being diverted or inspected. A Tarom flight traveling from Prague to Bucharest represents the latest reported incident.

item.title: West Indies Pacers Dominate Bangladesh to Take Control in Sylhet
item.description: West Indies fast bowlers put their team in a strong position against Bangladesh in Sylhet. Earlier, Hasan Mahmud claimed six wickets for 90 runs, achieving a rare milestone across different nations.

item.title: National Four Leaders' Name Removed From Ships
item.description: Authorities have altered the names of vessels previously designated after the national four leaders. This decision marks a change in maritime nomenclature related to those historical figures.

item.title: China Expands Rotorcraft Fleet Near Himalayan Border
item.description: Beijing is aggressively boosting its military helicopter fleet, potentially altering the strategic equilibrium against India in the Himalayas. New Delhi is actively upgrading its defensive measures to counter this rising aerial threat.

item.title: NIT Tiruchi Final-Year Student Dies in Hostel
item.description: A. Hrithik, a final-year B.Tech computer science student originating from the Chennai suburb of Thirumudivakkam, has died at his campus hostel.

item.title: Ministry Clears Twelve Additional ECMS Projects
item.description: The Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme has greenlit a dozen new initiatives. This program provides turnover-based financial incentives to businesses within the component sector.

item.title: Kochi Night Traffic Drive Penalizes Sixty Drivers
item.description: Kochi transport authorities collected 2.74 lakh rupees in penalties from sixty motorists during a targeted nighttime inspection. Led by Regional Transport Officer Biju Isaac, the crackdown targeted illegal vehicle alterations and noise violations.

item.title: Supreme Court Denies Tarun Tejpal Sentence Relief
item.description: The apex court declined to suspend the decade-long prison term given to Tarun Tejpal for a 2013 rape. Justices M.M. Sundresh and Prasanna B. Varale ruled the matter unsuitable for suspension while state appeals for a harsher penalty remain open.

item.title: Nithya Raman Elected to Lead Los Angeles
item.description: Nithya Raman transitioned from her Kerala roots to win the mayoral seat in Los Angeles, succeeding Karen Bass to govern America's second-largest city.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh Issues Over Four Thousand Diwali Licenses
item.description: Fire Services DG Venkata Ramana stated that authorities have authorized more than 4,200 festive firecracker vendors. Merchants must secure online permits and strictly adhere to safety rules during sales.

item.title: Significant Drop in Hyderabad Groundwater Table Observed Within a Single Month
item.description: Water tables across the greater Hyderabad region fell by one meter during the past month. Within the boundary of the Outer Ring Road, Kukatpally registered the lowest water level, whereas Shaikpet recorded the closest water table to the surface.

item.title: ইসরায়েলে আরব দলগুলোর সমর্থনে প্রধানমন্ত্রী পদের দৌড়ে এগিয়ে আইজেনকট
item.description: ইসরায়েলের প্রেসিডেন্ট হারজগের তথ্য অনুযায়ী, দেশের ৬৭ জন সংসদ সদস্যের সমর্থন পেয়ে নতুন প্রধানমন্ত্রী হওয়ার পথে রয়েছেন আইজেনকট। এই প্রক্রিয়ায় কয়েকটি আরব রাজনৈতিক দল তাকে সমর্থন জোগায়। অপরপক্ষে, বর্তমান প্রধানমন্ত্রী বেনিয়ামিন নেতানিয়াহুর পক্ষে অবস্থান নিয়েছেন ৪৬ জন আইনপ্রণেতা।

item.title: Four sports professionals evaluate recent Samsung smartwatch models
item.description: A diver, a judoka, a mountain climber, and a trail runner tested new Samsung smartwatches in their respective environments. They utilized the accompanying mobile health software to consolidate and analyze their performance data.

item.title: Indian Equity Benchmarks Rally as Sensex Rises 1,718 Points and Nifty Surpasses 25,000
item.description: Major Indian indices experienced sharp gains, with the Sensex leaping by 1,718 points while the Nifty moved back above the 25,000 threshold. Over a seven-day winning streak, the Sensex advanced by 7,781.99 points (10.62%), and the Nifty climbed 2,331.5 points (10.27%).

item.title: 'স্যরি' শব্দটি ব্যবহার না করেও যেভাবে অনুশোচনা প্রকাশ করা সম্ভব
item.description: শৈশব থেকেই পারিবারিক অভ্যাসের মাধ্যমে ভুল স্বীকারে নির্দিষ্ট বাক্য ব্যবহারের প্রচলন ঘটে। অভিভাবকের আদেশে ক্ষমা প্রার্থনার কারণে অনেক সময় এই প্রতিক্রিয়া কেবল আনুষ্ঠানিকতায় পরিণত হয়, যা আন্তরিকতার অভাব নির্দেশ করে। এই অবস্থায় প্রথাগত শব্দ এড়িয়েও নিজস্ব ভুল মেনে নেওয়ার উপায় রয়েছে।

item.title: Olivia Rodrigo Obtains Clearance From 1980s Band for Holiday Single
item.description: Pop musician Olivia Rodrigo reached out to the 1980s group The Waitresses to secure approval before putting out her latest holiday track. The resulting song was deliberately crafted to evoke a recognizable musical style.

item.title: Coach Domingo Departs Hampshire Following Demotion to Lower Division
item.description: Head coach Domingo has stepped down from Hampshire after a single year in charge. Following their drop from the top tier of the Championship, the cricket club plans to restructure its senior management team.

item.title: Apex Court Demands Goa Response Regarding Tarun Tejpal’s Conviction Appeal
item.description: India's highest judicial body has asked the state of Goa to address a legal challenge filed by Tarun Tejpal concerning his conviction in a sexual assault case. Tejpal reported to a local tribunal on September 14 to begin serving a ten-year sentence involving hard labor.

item.title: Perplexity Introduces Artificial Intelligence Assistants for Workplace Functions
item.description: Technology firm Perplexity has unveiled customized AI tools created to handle routine professional assignments. Described as digital colleagues, these automated systems aim to support users throughout their daily office operations.

item.title: Panjagutta Traffic Snarls From Gold Rush on Nov 6
item.description: Heavy traffic congestion occurred in Panjagutta, Hyderabad, on November 6 due to a surge of people seeking gold. Local merchants reported that the high customer volume did not translate into high sales.

item.title: Delhi-NCR Enforces GRAP 3 As Air Quality Turns Severe
item.description: Authorities enforced Stage 3 restrictions across the Delhi-NCR region after the regional Air Quality Index surpassed 400. The air pollution level entered the severe category on Friday.

item.title: New Delhi Air Force Sports Facility Closed Amid Land Recovery Order
item.description: Authorities have shut down the Air Force Sports Complex following Land and Development Office notices demanding possession of the Lok Kalyan Marg property.

item.title: Kalyn Ponga Returns To New Zealand Squad For Semi-Final
item.description: New Zealand added Kalyn Ponga and Phoenix Crossland to their roster for the upcoming 2026 Rugby League World Cup semi-final match against Tonga. Ponga returns to the bench three weeks after suffering a broken arm.

item.title: Machine Learning Uncovers Hidden Exoplanet In Webb Data
item.description: Astronomers utilized machine learning to eliminate stellar glare from James Webb Space Telescope imagery. This technique successfully revealed a previously obscured planet hiding near a star.

item.title: Puducherry Enforces Traffic And Parking Restrictions
item.description: Puducherry law enforcement established vehicle movement controls across the town effective through November 9. Designated parking zones for cars and motorbikes were set up at Anna Thidal and the Old Jail Complex.

item.title: Election Panel Grants Relief For Omitted Draft Roll Voters
item.description: The Election Commission provided a new chance for voters omitted from draft rolls in Delhi and six other states. The directive affects Maharashtra, Haryana, Andhra Pradesh, Jharkhand, Telangana, and Nagaland.

item.title: Indian-Origin Man Stands Trial For Wife's July 2024 Murder
item.description: Naresh Bhatt went on trial in the US accused of killing his wife, Mamta Kafle, in July 2024. During court proceedings, the defendant claimed she died by suicide and that he disposed of the body.

item.title: Two Men Arrested In Chennai For Cyber Fraud And Crypto Laundering
item.description: Enforcement Directorate officials apprehended Roshan Fiaz and Ammar in Chennai. The suspects face charges under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act regarding online scams and cryptocurrency laundering.

item.title: অভিনেতা মোহিত মালিক অন্তরঙ্গ দৃশ্যের আগে স্ত্রীর মত নিয়েছিলেন
item.description: ‘মির্জাপুর: দ্য মুভি’র রোমান্টিক দৃশ্যে অভিনয় করার পূর্বে সহ-শিল্পী রসিকা দুগাল ও অভিনেতা মোহিত মালিক নিজেদের অভিজ্ঞতা গণমাধ্যমে প্রকাশ করেছেন। শুটিং শুরুর পূর্বে মোহিত তাঁর স্ত্রীর কাছ থেকে অনুমতি নেন।

item.title: Gauhati High Court sets aside NSA order against activist Pranab Doley
item.description: The Gauhati High Court invalidated the Assam government's decision to apply the National Security Act against Pranab Doley. Authorities had detained him on July 30, following his bail in a protest case concerning a luxury hotel project near Kaziranga.

item.title: Nora Fatehi States She Holds Work Visa During Court Hearing
item.description: During court proceedings related to the Sukesh Chandrasekhar case, Nora Fatehi clarified that she is in India on a work visa. She additionally mentioned traveling to Chennai to meet Leena Paulose, the spouse of Chandrasekhar.

item.title: Indian Rupee rises 52 paise to finish at 93.89 versus U.S. dollar
item.description: The Indian rupee gained ground against the U.S. dollar, closing at 93.89. Market experts pointed to strong domestic equities and concerns over AI spending slowdown as contributing factors.

item.title: Karnataka tests reveal up to 31 percent ethanol in E20 fuel samples
item.description: Laboratory evaluations in Karnataka discovered ethanol levels reaching 31% in E20 petrol. The state food and civil supplies minister called for penalties against oil marketing companies and a consumer compensation fund.

item.title: Asian political parties adopt declaration opposing unilateral actions in Seoul
item.description: Delegates from 83 Asian political parties unanimously approved a declaration at the 13th ICAPP General Assembly in Seoul, running from November 4 to 6. The document urges adherence to international law and rejects unilateral measures.

item.title: Met Police Chief expects further complaints regarding Russell Brand
item.description: Sir Mark Rowley stated it is plausible that additional complaints could emerge against Russell Brand. The Metropolitan Police commissioner also criticized recent trial reports for bordering on victim blaming.

item.title: Government sources say satellite internet permit holders await security clearance
item.description: Jio, OneWeb, and Starlink possess satellite communication permissions, according to government insiders. Commercial services remain pending as they await final security clearances and spectrum pricing decisions.

item.title: Two Dead and 16 Hurt in French Bus Crash
item.description: Local authorities in the Ain area reported that a child and a young adult died in a bus crash. Sixteen other individuals sustained injuries, with three in critical condition.

item.title: NGT Mandates FIRs for Mineral Theft
item.description: The tribunal ruled that law enforcement and mining departments must file FIRs for stealing government minerals. It clarified that paying fines does not replace criminal charges.

item.title: Kerala Sees Slow Foreign Tourist Growth
item.description: Domestic visitor numbers rose by 10.47% over the previous year. Meanwhile, international tourist arrivals saw a minimal increase of 8.3%.

item.title: Study Shows Growth in Kerala Mangrove Cover
item.description: A Kochi-based CMFRI study comparing satellite data from 2017 to 2026 revealed mangrove expansion across coastal districts following earlier losses.

item.title: Nora Fatehi Attends Delhi Court Hearing
item.description: Actor Nora Fatehi testified as a scheduled witness before Additional Sessions Judge Gagandeep Singh. The legal proceedings related to the Sukesh Chandrasekhar case are ongoing.

item.title: New Summons Issued for Nora Fatehi in Extortion Case
item.description: Judge Gagandeep Singh summoned the actor again after showing frustration regarding a previous absence. The case involves Sukesh Chandrasekhar.

item.title: Tesla to Stop Cybertruck Production Next Year
item.description: CEO Elon Musk announced on X that the Texas facility will phase out Cybertruck manufacturing next year. The shift aims to increase production of robotaxis.

item.title: SpaceX shares drop amid broader technology and AI sell-off
item.description: Stock values for Elon Musk's SpaceX declined as markets responded to expectations of stricter regulatory oversight on artificial intelligence and data centers following US midterms.

item.title: Exercise Trial Results for Colon Cancer Patients
item.description: A large study revealed higher eight-year survival rates among colon cancer patients receiving prolonged exercise guidance. The trial evaluated the impact of physical activity post-treatment.

item.title: Election Commission reopens registration for voters left off draft lists
item.description: Citizens left off preliminary voter registries across seven states have been granted a fresh opportunity to submit their applications. The Election Commission announced this second chance to ensure eligible residents can register.
